query: SELECT c.id::int AS "id!" FROM twitch_clips_social_media c JOIN social_media_category k ON k.category_key = c.category_key LEFT JOIN social_media_clip_approval a ON a.clip_db_id = c.id WHERE c.discarded_at IS NULL AND NOT k.enrichment_enabled AND a.clip_db_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(c.status, 'pending') = 'pending' AND c.id BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT $1
